watchme: none, because the standing measurement is the ticket inspector's watchme_present check, which reports watchme_spec_error (receiver required) on every ticket at every pass once de9e31ef104c lands; a probe spec without a receiver reds there, so a watch would learn nothing new
children: probe-paths-that-name-nothing — the 50 specs whose probe file does not exist: read each, repoint a moved probe, or send its ticket to FIXME (a WATCHME whose probe was never built is incomplete). the-remaining-components-probes-get-receivers — every other component (librarian 5; cairn device, operator_inbox 4 each; aider_shim, learning_block, rehearsal, codemother, corrosion, db_domain, cc 3 each; then 1-2 each), cast one child per component as it is reached, from this parent.
